rv.q: His superb staging is as rich in detail as it is austere in execution.
This dazzling production is sure to bring goosebumps of excitement.
Sweeney Todd may be known as Sondheim's masterpiece, but this production of it is surely as good as any that have ever gone before, if not better.
Birmingham Rep has given it the revival it deserves.
An intimate yet chilling revival - and a solid introduction for those new to Sondheim's darker works.

cn.t: Critics hail this Birmingham Rep production as a superb revival of Sondheim's masterpiece, praising Joe Murphy's atmospheric direction, Ramin Karimloo's tremendous vocals, and its dark gothic humor that captivates and unsettles.
